WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id),
members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout),
web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
member_sales AS (
 SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id CROSS JOIN campaign
 WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
 GROUP BY 1),
by_group AS (SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 4) FROM by_group

SELECT s.store_id, w.status, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS dmin, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS dmax
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-15' OR CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
g AS (SELECT member_id,'t' grp FROM t UNION ALL SELECT member_id,'h' FROM h),
ver AS (SELECT g.grp, g.member_id, m.* FROM g JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=g.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to)
SELECT grp, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) dm, sum(CASE WHEN marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) consent, sum(CASE WHEN join_date>DATE '2025-11-24' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) joined_after, 
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Basic') basic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Silver') silver, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') gold, round(avg(datediff('day', join_date, DATE '2025-11-24')),0) avg_tenure
FROM ver GROUP BY grp
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', count(*), count(DISTINCT receipt_id*1000+line_no), 0,0,0,0,0,0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-15'

WITH campaign AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
member_sales AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id CROSS JOIN campaign
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
  GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales,0)) AS mean_t, COUNT(*) AS n FROM targeted x LEFT JOIN member_sales ms USING (member_id)),
h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales,0)) AS mean_h, COUNT(*) AS n FROM holdout x LEFT JOIN member_sales ms USING (member_id))
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, t.n AS targeted_members, h.n AS holdout_members, ROUND(t.mean_t,2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur, ROUND(h.mean_h,2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur, ROUND(t.mean_t - h.mean_h,2) AS uplift_eur, t.mean_t, h.mean_h
FROM t, h
